correctness.rationale: For q in [0,1] the substochastic killed transition M=[[q,1-q],[1-q,0]] gives F_n=pi M^(n-1)1 and exact F_1=1,F_2=1-q/2,F_n=qF_(n-1)+(1-q)^2F_(n-2). Direct expansion proves the four-day formula. The Perron root lambda=(q+sqrt(q^2+4(1-q)^2))/2 satisfies f_q(4/5)=-(q-3/5)^2 and is uniquely minimized at 3/5. A normalized nonnegative Perron eigenvector yields uniform F_n(q)>=lambda(q)^(n-1)/2, forcing all moving global minimizers to 3/5; local eigenprojection F_n=A lambda^(n-1)+(1-A)mu^(n-1) gives uniform logarithmic strict convexity and A(3/5)=9/10, A_prime=-3/5, log(lambda) second derivative 5/2. Stationarity holds at endpoints by the stipulated initial law. Independent complete binary-path enumeration in 48 rational small instances and symbolic recurrence checks agreed; finite checks are not the all-horizon proof.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification corroborates but cannot establish the all-parameter proof.
